subject: All identical estimates across over 10+ JSSAsecrD models

messages.author: e99a6e0ce88dcab6
messages.subject: All identical estimates across over 10+ JSSAsecrD models
parts:
Hi Murray and all,

I am trying to estimate leopard density. I have been through all steps in secr close models but all results may not be valid as the closure assumption is clearly violated.

In open models, I tried non-spatial models and the results looked OK. However, when I moved to spatial models, applying the same data set, I found that all estimates across > 10 models are identical (every decimal point).

I am really frustrated and would sincerely appreciate it if you could help me with this.

All details on the data and codes were attached (markdown document). Please feel free to use to bookmark to jump directly to the model fitting section.

Best regards,
Manoon

messages.author: 118cea91a1619106
messages.subject: Re: All identical estimates across over 10+ JSSAsecrD models
parts:
Manoon
I jumped to Model fitting and didn't find a clear illustration of your problem. Nor is it clear what data you have. I generally advise against using openCR for estimating density, I don't provide open-ended support for that package, and I suspect you are attempting too much with too few data. Identical fits probably indicate a complete failure of likelihood maximisation, but you can't expect us to do the work of tracking that down in a pile of unrelated stuff.
Murray
